classes.name: CSVScan
classes.description: A class that performs CSV data source scanning with filtering, schema, and splitability support in Spark.

methods.name: isSplitable
methods.description: Determines if the CSV file at the given path can be split based on CSV options and superclass logic.

methods.name: getFileUnSplittableReason
methods.description: Provides the reason why a file cannot be split, based on CSV options and superclass logic.

methods.name: createReaderFactory
methods.description: Creates a PartitionReaderFactory for reading CSV data, including validation and filter adjustments.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality of CSVScan instances based on schema, options, and filters.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the CSVScan instance.

methods.name: getMetaData
